# idsec_pcloud_local_group (Data Source)

Privilege Cloud local group data source, reads a Vault local group by its ID.
<!-- BEGIN CUSTOM NOTES -->
<!-- END CUSTOM NOTES -->

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) ID of the Vault local group to retrieve

### Optional

- `group_name` (String) Name of the Vault local group to retrieve

### Read-Only

- `created_time` (Number) Unix timestamp when the group was created
- `description` (String) Description of the Vault local group
- `group_type` (String) Type of the group as reported by the Vault
- `last_modified_time` (Number) Unix timestamp of the last modification to the group
- `location` (String) Vault location of the group, including a leading backslash
